proposal.hypothesis: Li2ZrO3 is a zirconate with good lithium ion conductivity and chemical stability; its Zr content may enhance compatibility with the Zr-containing LLZO electrolyte, potentially reducing reaction penalties.
proposal.motivation: The earlier evaluation of Li5TaO5 (mp-aaabqywz) showed the lowest penalty bin (3) among tested candidates, indicating that oxides with high-valent cations can have relatively low reactivity. Exploring Zr oxides, which share similarities with Ta/Nb oxides and are present in LLZO, may further optimize stability.
